# RefinedType {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
RefinedType
```
Abstract supertype for the refined classification schemes of spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs); see Weiß and Kim (2025). Concrete subtypes are [`RotationType`](RotationType.qmd), [`DirectionType`](DirectionType.qmd), and [`DiagonalType`](DiagonalType.qmd).
 


:::
